name: excellent
description: Restaurant groups' private dining, events and operations in ChatGPT: the morning brief, inquiries and booking, rooms, invoices and money owed, the staff week, training and marketing, with drafts a person decides in Excellent and changes that can be undone.

interface.longDescription:
Excellent is the operating platform for restaurant groups' private dining and events. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your group's live Excellent data in plain language: upcoming events and bookings across every location (one at a time in full, with its menu, contacts, payments, history, seating and custom fields), inbound leads, invoices and deposits still owed, proposals and contracts, rooms and when they are available, the staff schedule and training roster, an agenda of the coming days, one search across all of it, and the group events report with booking pace against your revenue goal.

With draft access, ChatGPT can also draft into your team's review queues: a reply to an inquiry, a proposal, banquet event order or contract priced from your own menus, an invoice or a payment installment on one, the day's pre-shift note, a staff shift, a thank-you card, a social post, a bilingual guest email, a training course built from your own lessons, new words for one of your automatic event emails, and, with Excellent Partner, a pro forma, pitch deck or investor update whose figures Excellent traces from your own records. It can revise a social post, guest email or invoice that is still a draft, and stage a table of contacts, menu items, inquiries, past events, staff or social posts as an import. Each comes with a review link that works only for you, signed in to Excellent; nothing is sent, published, added or finalized until you decide it there.

With change access, it can also make everyday changes as you, each one undoable for 30 days: create and book events, hold, block or book rooms, close a venue for a holiday or a buyout, turn a hold into an event, move an event or an inquiry along the pipeline, change a guest count, host, extra rooms, table seating or custom field, assign or snooze an inquiry, add contacts, notes and investor contacts, keep look-alike contacts apart, create a marketing list, add staff and correct their details, define competencies and assign training. It never sends, publishes, takes payments or deletes a record: clearing a value is an undoable change like any other, and undo takes back only what its own change did.

Each connection sees exactly one restaurant group, the one you approve, and acts as you, with only what your role in Excellent allows. Amounts are returned in cents. You choose read-only, drafts, or drafts and changes on Excellent's approval screen, and you can disconnect any time from Settings → AI assistant access in Excellent.

Requires an Excellent account. Docs: beexcellent.ai/mcp.
defaultPrompt: What does the next two weeks of private events look like across all our locations?
Which new leads haven't been contacted yet, and what dates and party sizes are they asking about?
How are we pacing against this year's events revenue goal, and which location is behind?
